description: Truth-blind P3/P5-scored scanner proposals passed through the existing V5 numeric recognizer and official PP-OCRv5 path, followed by aggregate truth comparison.
crop_geometry: each proposal's exact 256x96 P1 crop centered on the predicted ink stroke is supplied as a whole-region OCR crop; this is not a text-box localization
numeric_cropper: OcrCropBatcher 128x32, horizontal padding 12, vertical padding 1, content margin ratio 0.25, preserve-aspect-pad, padding value 1.0
official_cropper: OcrCropBatcher 320x48, horizontal padding 8, vertical padding 2, preserve-aspect-pad, padding value 0.5
official_rule: record official result when it returns a nonempty GraphNumber grammar match; preserve V8 OfficialMinimumConfidence=0 and do not impose a new confidence threshold
truth_access: only after both recognizers complete and their frozen result file is hash-verified
acceptance_status: exploratory consumed synthetic development diagnostic only
